answer: Make standing a continuity streak, not a balance: weight grows only along an unbroken spiral of participation across consecutive beacon rounds, and a single missed round snaps the vine back to zero. An honest key tends one continuous thread. A farm cannot keep thousands of fakes each answering every round through real work per head, and any lapse refracts their progress through a prism back to the start, so holding many aged identities costs continuous effort no attacker sustains at scale.
